_comment: Sous-titres anglais incrustés par scripts/meta-review/build_video.py. Un chapitre = un clip enregistré dans docs/meta-app-review/clips/<clip>. Les étapes s'affichent l'une après l'autre, réparties sur la durée du clip ; le titre (permissions) reste affiché en haut pendant tout le clip.

chapters.title: Facebook Login — permissions: pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement
steps: ClosRM is a CRM for coaches who get clients from Instagram. The coach opens Settings › Integrations.
The Meta card shows 'not connected'. The coach clicks 'Connect Meta' (Connecter Meta).
Facebook Login opens. The coach is logged in to their own Facebook account.
pages_show_list: ClosRM lists the Pages the coach manages. The coach selects their Page…
…and the Instagram professional account linked to it (@account visible here).
The coach reviews the requested permissions and clicks 'Continue / Allow' to grant them.
Back in ClosRM: connected. pages_read_engagement lets ClosRM read the selected Page to find its linked Instagram account.

chapters.title: Permission: instagram_basic
steps: The coach opens Acquisition › Social networks (Réseaux sociaux) › Instagram.
instagram_basic: ClosRM shows the connected account's profile — username, picture, follower count.
It lists the account's own posts and reels, so each lead can be linked to the content that brought them.
Same account, as shown on Instagram.

chapters.title: Permission: instagram_manage_messages
steps: Step 1 — Asset: the connected Instagram account (@account) is visible in ClosRM Messages.
The coach opens the conversation with a prospect (test account).
Step 2 — The coach types a reply in ClosRM and clicks Send (Envoyer).
Step 3 — The message is delivered in the native Instagram client (instagram.com, prospect's inbox).
The prospect replies on Instagram; the reply appears in ClosRM, next to the lead's record.

chapters.title: Permission: instagram_manage_comments
steps: The coach opens a post of the connected account in ClosRM.
instagram_manage_comments: ClosRM lists the comments on the coach's own post.
The coach replies to a comment from ClosRM and clicks Reply (Répondre).
The reply is published under the post on Instagram.

chapters.title: Permission: instagram_manage_insights
steps: The coach opens the Reels tab of the connected account in ClosRM.
instagram_manage_insights: plays, reach, saves and shares of the coach's own reels.
The coach compares them to see which content brings leads.

chapters.title: Permission: instagram_content_publish
steps: The coach prepares a post in ClosRM's content planner: image + caption.
The coach clicks Publish (Publier). ClosRM publishes it to the connected Instagram account.
The post is live on the coach's Instagram profile.
